security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documented API-key references, examples, and user-facing URLs. The script intentionally sends targets and a bearer credential to BrowserAct over HTTPS, which creates an external trust boundary. Publication should wait until instructions no longer ask users to provide API keys through the agent or chat.

remediation.issue: The skill tells users to provide a BrowserAct API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally. Remove requests to provide keys through chat and remove the matching script message.

remediation.issue: Target values and workflow data cross a third-party service boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the BrowserAct data transfer and recommend reviewing its privacy, retention, and acceptable-use terms before processing sensitive targets.

content.user_title: Find Official Business Websites and Social Profiles
content.value_statement: Finding verified business websites and social profiles manually takes time. This skill sends a company name or website URL to BrowserAct and returns discovered links.
actual_capabilities: Determines whether the target is a company name or website URL.
Submits company names to a predefined BrowserAct business contact workflow.
Submits website URLs to a predefined BrowserAct social links workflow.
Polls workflow status every ten seconds for up to fifteen minutes.
Returns the official website and discovered LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok links.
Reports authentication failures, task limits, failed tasks, and polling timeouts.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account, a valid API key, network access, and available workflow capacity.
Sends target values to BrowserAct and depends on that service for execution and results.
Processes one command-line target per execution and does not provide native batch input.
Does not independently prove that every discovered profile is current or officially controlled.

use_cases.title: Enrich Sales Leads
use_cases.description: Add official websites and social channels to prospect records before outreach.

use_cases.title: Map Competitor Channels
use_cases.description: Identify which supported social platforms competitors use and collect their profile links.

use_cases.title: Maintain Business Directories
use_cases.description: Find missing websites and social profiles for local business listings.

prompt_templates.title: Find One Company
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official website and social profiles for {company_name}. Return each discovered platform with its canonical URL.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a simple company lookup.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Website
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract all supported social profile links from {website_url}. Group results by platform and flag duplicate URLs.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user already knows the official website.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Companies
prompt_templates.prompt: Research {company_list} one company at a time. Return official websites and supported social links in a comparison table.
prompt_templates.scenario: An analyst compares the online presence of several businesses.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich a Lead List
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich {lead_list} with official websites and social profiles. Keep source targets, remove duplicate links, and mark missing platforms without guessing.
prompt_templates.scenario: A sales team needs traceable, cleaned enrichment results.

output_examples.input: A company name such as OpenAI
output: Official website: the discovered canonical website
Social profiles: discovered LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok links

output_examples.input: A website URL such as https://www.rotorooter.com/
output: Other supported platforms: each discovered canonical profile URL

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before invocation. Never paste the key into prompts or chat.
Review BrowserAct privacy terms before submitting targets. Confirm authorization when processing customer, prospect, or personal data.
Verify discovered URLs against the official website and platform branding before using them for outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into conversations, command arguments, reports, or shared logs.
Do not treat every returned link as verified ownership without an independent review.
Do not perform bulk collection without checking applicable privacy rules, consent requirements, and platform terms.

faq.question: Does this skill require a BrowserAct account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a valid BrowserAct API key and access to the referenced workflow templates.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide one company name or one website URL per script execution.

faq.question: Which social platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The documented outputs include LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

faq.question: Where is my target processed?
faq.answer: The script sends the target to BrowserAct over HTTPS for remote workflow execution.

faq.question: How long can a lookup take?
faq.answer: The script polls every ten seconds and stops after fifteen minutes without completion.

faq.question: Are returned profiles guaranteed to be official?
faq.answer: No. Review the returned website and profile links before relying on them.
